notes: Sea Cliff / Richmond, sheet 4: hatched first-residential blocks (1327-1334, 1387-1390) with printed dimensions (240, 70, 120 in and beside the blocks), then plain blocks 1384-1386 and the Clement St commercial strips. The double-line road entering from the left between 1328 and 1327 (about 3700-3825, 2245-2312) is read as a street drawn as two lines; its enclosed paper has no seed, so it is street. The small unhatched rectangle in 1331 (4276-4321, 2195-2246) and the unhatched strip in 1387 (x 4276-4321) are lots inside their blocks, not blocks of their own. Strokes close two small gaps in printed block sides: 1386's east side at (4467, 2375-2390) 1385's west side at (4500, 2405-2415), and 1459's west side at (4209, 3117-3122). Two short strokes along block edges cut street marks (an R at 4642-4660, 2572-2600 under 1384, a 90 at 4649-4662, 2899-2926 over 1456) off the blocks they touch, so the marks stay street.
